scope: Owned AppKit fixtures and read-only per-PID AX probes on macOS 27.0.1 arm64. No TCC mutation, unrelated-process inspection, synthetic input, or product change.

reader.interpretation: The caller was AX-trusted and received successful calls, so this sample is not a reader-side permission error, timeout, or global pagination artifact. It does not prove every TCC attribution or provider state is sound.

existing_poc_helper_binary.AXIsProcessTrusted_this_round: not sampled inside this helper; the independent owned-PID readers were trusted and reproduced the pre-helper failure

assessment.observed_fault_layer: The owned AppKit provider can return its correct NSWindow on the main thread, while the remote AXWindows array yields a ref to AXApplication. The exact cross-process conversion or system state causing this is unresolved.
assessment.authority_rule: CGWindow may identify a candidate PID/window for diagnostics; no grant/action is authorized until a live AXWindow ref maps to the same PID and native window ID. Unknown fails closed.
unpassed: background-only title grant on App-root samples
